I was told when I was going through a very serious mental health crisis “what do you want me to do about it my hands are tied” I’ve had numerous medical issues that they constantly dismiss. The display of medical misogyny in this practise is shocking. Everyday I’m in agony and they refuse to look in to it further. They regularly dismiss female related medical issues as “anxiety or depression” and send you on your way. They lack care and empathy for patients. You can’t even get a face to face appointment with them. By far this is the worst GP surgery ive ever dealt with. I referenced that I had some past traumas on the phone as a reason to why my health might be deteriorating and I was met with sniggering as if it was a laughing matter. The doctors at this practise don’t seem to care about peoples health. It’s very disappointing.\n\nUpdate 20/10/2025* I’ve tried on multiple occasions to make a complaint about the surgery but since the person to complain too is dr potters wife I have been unable to do so. I’ve been told on numerous occasions that she will call me tomorrow, the next day, next week etc and I’ve never received a call from her making it impossible to complain about the way they’ve treated me. I want to escalate my complaint to the relevant people beyond the surgery but I’m unable to do so as mrs potter won’t take my initial complaint. Absolute shambles for a gp surgery.",null,[0,237]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data\u003d!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRbmZpU1N3EAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x59a211a53468d581!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgMCQnfiSSw%7C%7C?hl\u003den"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId\u003dChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRbmZpU1N3EAE\u0026t\u003d1\u0026entityid\u003dChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNRbmZpU1N3Ei0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdNQ1FuZmlTeXdFEhJDZ3NJaUlHbnZnWVE4UEhMSlEaLAoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ01DUW5maVNLdxISQ2dzSWlJR252Z1lROFBITEpRIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARgdVoNKURolkqEkNnc0lpSUdudmdZUThQSExKUQ\u0026wv\u003d1\u0026d\u003d286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiZr4__oLaTAxUTEWMBHT4iKXEQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiZr4__oLaTAxUTEWMBHT4iKXEQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMWxCUlhwaE4xOWZSV2hDTkhKRVdURlNjRzlYZFRkMVdsOUhNRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEptUlVOYVowRlVUbkp6V1VGRFNVRQ\u003d\u003d"],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYdzV1N0l3EAE",["0x0:0x59a211a53468d581",null,1730305596633593,1730305596633593,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/101332280683175449719/reviews?hl\u003den"],null,null,["Xeno Batt","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXIRsD5tUg7zfrQCA8bEQN1tvAe9JVDnCYxOTrkfJWcpnIFgnoN\u003ds120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/101332280683175449719?hl\u003den"],"101332280683175449719",null,5,1,null,[0,3,1],1,["5 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiZr4__oLaTAxUTEWMBHT4iKXEQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["My wife and I have been patients of this practice for many years, and in that time we have been fortunate to have Dr Potter as our GP.
